Selected Work

Lotus – A Vietnamese Lotus Pond

Illustrator · Typography · Mockup

Concept. The lotus grows out of mud yet still blooms and gives off fragrance. I wanted to tell that journey through colour: as sunlight touches the pond, soft pink turns into blended red, orange, purple and gold.

Design. I started with pencil sketches, redrew the lotus in a flat style using five main colours, and designed a tall, bold Lotus wordmark that follows the curve of the stem.

Applications. The artwork is applied to a 148 × 210 mm spiral notebook as the main product, with a phone case, bookmark and water bottle as secondary items.

E-commerce Website Redesign

Figma · UI/UX · Responsive

A minimal, dark redesign of an AirPod 5 product page. The product photo leads, the “Buy now” button stands out, and the layout adapts across mobile, tablet and desktop. This is a student concept project.

Starbucks – UI/UX Redesign

Figma · Prototype · Design system

Goal. Help customers choose a drink or food item, set size and sweetness, and order in just a few steps.

Design. Keeps Starbucks’ signature green, with large product cards, easy-to-tap “+” buttons and member offer banners such as “Buy 3 get 1”. Food uses a soft orange background to set it apart from drinks.

Scope. 12 mobile screens: sign in, coffee, drink and food menus, item details, order success, Rewards membership, stores, about us and responsibility. The interface text is in Vietnamese. This is a student concept project, not affiliated with Starbucks.
